get.summary: Get planned shifts, optionally those approved on or after a specified date and time
get.description:
This endpoint returns all planned (unconfirmed) shifts, broken down into 30-minute segments, along with
some details about the staff working the shift and the shift's cost.

When a date and time are provided via `since`, the data returned by this endpoint is limited to only shifts
planned on or after the supplied date and time.

When a date and time are provided via `until`, the data returned by this endpoint is limited to only shifts
planned on or before the supplied date and time.

The returned data will be paginated because of the large volumes that will be returned, result count can be
modified with `per_page` up-to a maximum of 500.

When a date and time are provided via `until`, the data returned by this endpoint is limited to only shifts

modified with `per_page` up-to a maximum of 500.
